args.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a single square home-screen icon exploration for the Creation story, readable at 60 pixels.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET: the beloved existing Creation mosaic.
Primary request: create a close-up of the most compelling connection in this picture, the brilliant golden light flowing down into the curling turquoise wave. Reframe and zoom tightly into those two forms: a radiant light above and left of center and one large blue wave curling beneath it. Let a narrow sweep of emerald and amber at the right recall living earth; bird and fish fall outside this closer composition. Keep the distinctive sweeping asymmetric rays, deep indigo, sapphire and turquoise glass, warm gold and ivory, handmade irregular gold joints and luminous translucent material. Preserve the source's identity and flowing character; this should feel like moving closer to this very artwork.
The light and wave together occupy almost the entire square and remain readable as two dominant forms. Reduce incidental surface noise slightly but keep the source's mosaic craft. No new symbols, no words, no figures. Opaque finished artwork extending to every edge, straight square corners, no frame, no border, no circle, no icon mockup, no montage. Output one square image.

Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: a single square home-screen icon exploration for the Creation story, readable at 60 pixels and 32 pixels.
Input image 1 is the EDIT TARGET and material reference: the beloved existing Creation mosaic.
Primary request: redesign this composition as a much simpler luminous mosaic, preserving its soul and its unusual flow between light, water and life. Just two dominant gestures: a radiant ivory-gold point above and left of center with five or six broad curved rays, and one very large turquoise wave curling upward from the lower left beneath it. A single broad emerald sweep at the right gives a quiet hint of living earth. Remove the bird, fish, small leaves, branching filigree, extra spirals, small tile network and microtexture. Make the luminous center a clear compact shape against a wide calm deep-indigo field. Use fewer, much larger pieces of sapphire, turquoise, warm gold, ivory and emerald glass; fine gold joints only at major piece boundaries. Keep subtle tactile glass variation and warm sacred-art luminosity, subordinate to clear large masses. Preserve graceful asymmetric curves and the strong blue/gold relationship of the original. Avoid a generic sun-over-ocean landscape: these shapes remain interwoven abstract currents. This must still feel like the same beloved artwork, newly drawn for tiny size.
Opaque edge-to-edge square, straight square corners. No circle, frame, border, letter, words, extra motifs, device mockup, or comparison sheet. Output one square image.

item_export.method: sips resampling of the existing circular original; no redraw
